name: Jim Banks
committees: Senate Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs
stance: Frames frontier AI as a defining national-security problem — focused on protecting military AI and frontier labs' model weights from insider theft, sabotage, and backdoors.

statements.text: Wrote to the Secretary of War and OMB urging stronger counterintelligence protections against insider threats at frontier AI companies — model-weight theft, sabotage and backdoors, and CCP espionage — and requested a staff briefing.
the race to develop and deploy advanced SI will be a defining national security issue of our time
a single compromised or malicious insider with sufficient access could reveal secret information about military uses of SI, expose model weights, or attempt to sabotage SI systems via backdoors

review.note: added October 2026 from banks.senate.gov primary sources; quotes verified verbatim
